manifest.name: kidai-snapshot-guard
manifest.productName: Kidai Snapshot Guard 纪代快照守护
manifest.description: Kidai Snapshot Guard: in-DSH backup manager for DeepSeek Harness. Automatic known-good snapshots before DSH closes, pending→verified promotion on successful boot, manual save, single-zip full-disk export/import/restore, and read+restore compatibility with dsh-plugin-guard / dsh-config-manager backups. Management page lives in 设置 → 纪代备份 (settings.section); the external Kidai Plugin Remote reads the same snapshot store.

bundle.text:
# Kidai Snapshot Guard bundle patch: one host row mounts the guard.
- insert:
    - id: snapshot-guard
      name: 'kidai-snapshot-guard'

readme.text: <div align="center">

readme.section: 💾 Kidai Snapshot Guard · 纪代快照守护
readme.text: **DSH 内部的自动备份管家** —— 关门前保存 · 开机后确认 · 一键回滚 **简体中文** · [**English**](README.en.md) ---

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的配置改动（装插件、更新、启停）一旦让 DSH 起不来，
最需要的是「改之前的样子」。**纪代快照守护**在 DSH **内部**自动完成快照的
「保存 → 确认 → 恢复」闭环，并与外部的 [**Kidai Plugin Remote**](https://github.com/NokorinNishikino/kidai-plugin-remote)
共享同一份存储——DSH 起不来时，外部管理器照样能回滚。

- 💾 **关闭前自动保存** —— 每次 DSH 正常关闭都保留一版最近良好快照
  （配置 + 设置 + 第三方插件目录），滚动保留最新 3 份
- ✅ **开机自动确认** —— 每次成功启动，把待确认快照转为「已验证」（保留到下次成功运行）
- 📦 **单 zip 备份** —— 整个快照一键导出 / 导入 / 恢复为一个离线 zip——DSH 起不来也能恢复
- 🔄 **隔离自动恢复** —— 外部管理器的「一次性隔离」被打断时，下次启动自动还原隔离前配置
- 🔔 **启动通知** —— 「纪代备份」页顶部显示启动成功 / 自动恢复提示
- 🧩 **兼容读取** —— 兼容读取并恢复 dsh-plugin-guard 回滚与 dsh-config-manager 快照
- ✏️ **快照备注** —— 给任意快照加备注便于分辨（与外部管理器双向同步）

> **装好即用** —— 随 DSH 启动，无需任何操作；打开「设置 → 纪代备份」即可管理。

---
```bash

readme.section: 方式一：GitHub 直装（发布后可用）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:NokorinNishikino/kidai-snapshot-guard

readme.section: 方式二：本地开发（从 kidai-plugin-remote 仓库目录）
readme.text:
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-guard.ps1
```

**重启 DSH** 后生效，打开「设置 → 纪代备份」即可使用。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove kidai-snapshot-guard
```

或手动清理：从 `profiles/desktop/package.json` 移除 `kidai-snapshot-guard`
的依赖与 bundle 声明，再删除 `node_modules/kidai-snapshot-guard` 目录。

> **独立使用**：KSG 是**完全独立的备份插件**，不需要 Kidai Plugin Remote 也能
> 自动快照、导出、恢复；外部管理器只是额外的外部回滚入口（DSH 起不来时用）。

然后在 DSH 内：

- 打开 **设置 → 纪代备份** —— 管理快照、导出/导入、容量配额。
- 或用 `/kidai-snapshot` 斜杠命令查看只读摘要。

---

| 仓库 | 职责 | 运行位置 |
|---|---|---|
| **kidai-snapshot-guard**（你在这里） | 快照、待确认→已验证、隔离恢复 | DSH 内部（插件） |
| [**kidai-plugin-remote**](https://github.com/NokorinNishikino/kidai-plugin-remote) | 外部管理与回滚界面 | DSH 之外 |
| [**kidai-plugin-remote-client**](https://github.com/NokorinNishikino/kidai-plugin-remote-client) | 同一管理器，原生窗口，零依赖 | DSH 之外 |

快照存储（`$DSH_HOME/.kidai-snapshots`）与守护目录（`$DSH_HOME/guard/`）
两端共享：在这里保存的快照，外部管理器同样可见、可回滚；反之亦然。

---

- **关闭时** — dispose 效果在关闭流程等待期间拍**全量快照**（配置 + 设置 +
  第三方包目录）；同步的 `exit` 事件轻量快照（配置 + 设置，不含包目录）作为
  兜底；30 秒内去重，一次关闭 = 一份快照。
- **启动时** — 待确认快照转为 `verified`；维护滚动 `known-good` 快照
  （固定 id），profile 插件集变化时（30 秒监视器）刷新。
- **一次性隔离** — 读取外部管理器的隔离标记；若本次启动的 DSH 不是管理器
  spawn 的那一个（PID 不匹配：管理器被杀，或直接从快捷方式启动），则还原
  隔离前配置并清除标记——**隔离只影响一次启动**，无论谁启动 DSH。
- **API** — DSH webServer 上的 `/api/kidai-snapshot/*`：status / list / save /
  known-good / delete / export / exports / import / restore / foreign /
  foreign-restore / settings / quota / meta / notice / note。
- **宿主友好 & 防御式** — 每个操作都有包裹，守护插件永远不会拖垮启动，
  也不会阻塞关闭超过限定时间。

```
kidai-snapshot-guard/
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js    # 插件入口：启动钩子、关闭钩子、路由注册
│   ├── backup.js   # 快照引擎：创建/导出/导入/恢复、配额、隔离标记
MIT
<div align="center">
**The automatic in-DSH backup manager** — save on close · verify on boot · rollback in one click [**简体中文**](README.md) · **English** ---

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) config changes (install / update / toggle) can leave
DSH unbootable — the thing you need most is "what it looked like before".
**Kidai Snapshot Guard** runs **inside** DSH and automates the snapshot loop
(save → verify → restore), sharing one store with the external
[**Kidai Plugin Remote**](https://github.com/NokorinNishikino/kidai-plugin-remote)
— so even when DSH can't boot, the external manager can still roll back.

- 💾 **Auto save on close** — every graceful close keeps a known-good snapshot
  (config + settings + third-party plugin dirs), rolling the latest 3
- ✅ **Verified on boot** — each successful start promotes pending snapshots →
  **verified** ("kept until the next successful run")
- 📦 **Single-zip backup** — export / import / restore a whole snapshot as one
  offline zip — even when DSH can't boot
- 🔄 **Isolation auto-recovery** — if the external manager's one-shot isolated
  run was interrupted, the previous config is restored on next launch
- 🔔 **Launch notices** — success / auto-recovery toasts on the 纪代备份 page
- 🧩 **Compatibility** — reads and restores dsh-plugin-guard rollbacks and
  dsh-config-manager snapshots
- ✏️ **Snapshot notes** — annotate any snapshot to tell them apart (synced with
  the external manager)

> **Install and forget** — starts with DSH, no setup needed; open
> 设置 → 纪代备份 to manage.

---
```bash

readme.section: Option A: direct from GitHub (once published)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:NokorinNishikino/kidai-snapshot-guard

readme.section: Option B: local development (from the kidai-plugin-remote checkout)
readme.text:
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-guard.ps1
```

**Restart DSH** afterwards, then open 设置 → 纪代备份.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove kidai-snapshot-guard
```

or manually: remove the `kidai-snapshot-guard` dependency and bundle entry from
`profiles/desktop/package.json`, then delete the
`node_modules/kidai-snapshot-guard` directory.

> **Standalone**: KSG is a **fully independent backup plugin** — it works
> without Kidai Plugin Remote (auto snapshots, export, restore); the external
> manager is only an extra rollback entry for when DSH can't boot.

Then, inside DSH:

- Open **设置 → 纪代备份** — manage snapshots, export/import, quota.
- Or use the `/kidai-snapshot` slash command for a read-only summary.

---

| Repo | Role | Runs where |
|---|---|---|
| **kidai-snapshot-guard** (you are here) | snapshots, pending→verified, isolation recovery | inside DSH |
| [**kidai-plugin-remote**](https://github.com/NokorinNishikino/kidai-plugin-remote) | external management & rollback UI | outside DSH |
| [**kidai-plugin-remote-client**](https://github.com/NokorinNishikino/kidai-plugin-remote-client) | same manager, native window, zero deps | outside DSH |

The store (`$DSH_HOME/.kidai-snapshots`) and the guard directory
(`$DSH_HOME/guard/`) are shared: a snapshot saved here is visible and
rollback-able from the external manager, and vice versa.

---

- **On close** — a dispose effect takes a FULL snapshot (config + settings +
  third-party package dirs) while the shutdown flow awaits it; a synchronous
  `exit`-event light snapshot (config + settings, no package dirs) is the
  universal fallback. Deduped within 30 s so one shutdown = one snapshot.
- **On boot** — pending snapshots are promoted to `verified`; a rolling
  `known-good` snapshot is maintained (pinned id) and refreshed when the
  profile's plugin set changes (30 s watcher).
- **One-shot isolation** — reads the external manager's isolation marker; if
  the DSH that launched is not the one the manager spawned (PID mismatch:
  manager killed, or DSH launched directly from a shortcut), the pre-isolation
  config is restored and the marker cleared — isolation only ever affects ONE
  launch, no matter who starts DSH.
- **API** — `/api/kidai-snapshot/*` on the DSH webServer: status / list /
  save / known-good / delete / export / exports / import / restore / foreign /
  foreign-restore / settings / quota / meta / notice / note.
- **Host-only & defensive** — every operation is wrapped so the guard can
  never break boot or block shutdown beyond a bounded timeout.

```
kidai-snapshot-guard/
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js    # plugin entry: boot hooks, close hooks, route registration
│   ├── backup.js   # snapshot engine: create/export/import/restore, quota, isolation marker
MIT
